name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Beatrix, Fletcher, and Tanner go with 2 coins, 4 coins, and 10 coins, in some order.
Rowan goes with exactly one of Potter, 2 coins, or 10 coins.
Exactly one of these is true: Cedric goes with Tanner; Matilda goes with Weaver; Rowan goes with Fletcher.
Between Wulfric and 10 coins, one goes with Blacksmith and the other with Tanner.
Cedric goes with exactly one of Potter, Weaver, or 6 coins.
Either Potter goes with Beatrix or Cedric goes with 4 coins.
